title: Exact Hausdorff dimension of Liouville quantum gravity
precise_working_target: For every fixed gamma in (0,2), determine the deterministic almost-sure intrinsic Hausdorff dimension d_gamma of the canonical gamma-LQG metric for a whole-plane GFF with additive constant fixed. No elementary closed form is assumed to exist. Equivalently in the subcritical range, determine the actual LFPP relation Q(xi), with xi=gamma/d_gamma and Q(xi)=2/gamma+gamma/2. Normalizing the metric by a positive deterministic constant does not change the dimension.
